links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of automated occlusion detection versus radiology report reference standard on local data
links.effect: Sensitivity/specificity: aLVO 91%/93%; all LVO 73%/92%; aLVO+M2 74%/93%; aLVO+all MeVO 65%/93%. High for aLVO, lower for pLVO and MeVO.
links.quote: The automated algorithm demonstrated high accuracy in identifying anterior LVO with lower performance for pLVO and MeVO.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a commercially deployed AI tool (Viz.ai) in routine clinical care for detecting large and medium vessel occlusions in code stroke patients.
